interface.title: ExoPlanet AI | Kepler CNN Detector
interface.stage_of_work: Screening candidates and checking a trained classifier: scoring single Kepler stars for planet-candidate status and reviewing how the model performs
interface.what_it_is_for: Look up a Kepler star by KIC number, download its PDCSAP light curve from MAST, run a fixed preprocessing pipeline and a 1D-CNN to score it as a planet candidate against a calibrated 0.6914 threshold, and optionally run a phase-fold eclipsing-binary check using the star's orbital period.

data.note: Four built-in demo stars (KIC 10666592 Kepler-2b, 11446443 Kepler-1b, 9941662 Kepler-13b, 3335816 equal-eclipse EB) fill in catalog periods automatically. Light curves are always fetched live from MAST. In this sandbox every fetch failed with a proxy 403 error ('Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden'), so no star was ever scored. The Performance page charts (ROC, score histogram, SNR-tier bars, weekly table) are built-in static results and do render. Every saved PNG in the Performance gallery and the About page appears as a broken image, on both 127.0.0.1 and localhost.

features.name: Target picker with catalog-linked parameter auto-fill
features.general: Choose a target either from a curated example list or by typing an ID; known targets fill a dependent parameter from a catalog, which the user can then override, and a value of 0 turns the dependent check off
features.specific: Type a KIC number or choose one of four demo stars; the 'Orbital period (days) for EB check' field fills from the app's period catalog (with an info banner saying where the value came from, including the half-period case for equal-eclipse EBs). Unknown KICs reset it to 0, meaning the EB check is skipped, and the dropdown takes priority over the text box.
steps: Type a KIC number or open the demo-star dropdown and choose a star
Read the auto-fill banner (catalog period, half-period note, or 'no period — EB check skipped')
Optionally edit the period with the +/- stepper or by typing
serves_tasks: Pick a pre-validated example target, which also fills in its known period
Type in an arbitrary target ID
Supply or override the period used for the false-positive check

features.name: Remote fetch with staged progress and input validation
features.general: Check the identifier, then fetch data from a remote archive behind a progress status panel that collapses into a success or failure summary you can expand for detail
features.specific: Run Detection Pipeline rejects non-integer KICs inline, then shows '📡 Contacting MAST archive …' / 'Searching MAST for KIC …' with a progress bar. The panel then collapses into an expander; in this run that was always 'Download failed' holding the full MAST error text.
steps: Watch the status panel and progress bar during the MAST search
Read the inline validation error, or expand the collapsed result panel to read the detail
serves_tasks: Fetch the target's light curve and run the classifier on it
Type in an arbitrary target ID

features.name: Class-separated score histogram with threshold line
features.general: Overlay score distributions for each class with the decision threshold marked; toggle classes on and off and zoom into the region around the threshold to see where the classes overlap
features.specific: Score Distribution plot: Planet candidates, Non-planets/Variables and Eclipsing binaries histograms over CNN score, with a dashed 'Threshold 0.6914' line. Legend click hides a class, box-drag zooms, double-click on the plot resets.
steps: Read the overlaid class histograms against the threshold line
Click a legend entry to hide a class (the axis rescales)
Drag a box around the threshold to zoom in
Double-click the plot to reset the view
serves_tasks: See how true and false positives are spread around the decision threshold

features.name: ROC comparison with threshold operating points
features.general: Compare ROC curves from two evaluation sets and mark where the old and new decision thresholds sit, with hover readout and per-curve isolation
features.specific: ROC Curves chart: Week 6 competition (AUC 0.9628) and Week 7-8 wild data (AUC 0.6933) against a random diagonal, with a Pre-cal threshold dot (0.28, 0.93) and a Post-cal threshold star. Hover reads out the coordinates and a legend double-click isolates a curve.
steps: Read each curve's AUC from the legend
Hover a threshold marker to read its FPR and TPR
Double-click a legend entry to isolate one curve
serves_tasks: Inspect the ROC curves and the operating points of the decision threshold

features.name: Metrics comparison table across evaluation rounds
features.general: Tabulate the same evaluation metrics for each model version or evaluation set in one scrollable table, so changes between rounds can be read off row by row
features.specific: Weekly Results Comparison table, scrolling inside its own frame from Week 6 competition test to Week 9A broader catalog, with columns AUC, Precision, F1, High-SNR DR, Low-SNR DR, FPR, EB catch and Note.
steps: Scroll the table within its frame to reach later rows
Compare AUC, precision, F1 and FPR between rows
Read the Note column for what changed in each row
serves_tasks: Compare evaluation metrics across development stages and datasets

features.specific: Detection Rate by SNR Tier grouped bars: TPR 93% / 45% / 7% for High / Medium / Low SNR and 0% for EBs, with FPR 0% / 5% / 0% / 0% beside them.
